def replace_comma_in_text(text):
    """
    Parameters
    ----------
    text: str of nominal values for a single mushroom species from primary_data_edited.csv

    Returns
    -------
    replace commas outside of angular brackets with semicolons (but not inside of them)

    Example
    -------
    text = "[a, b], [c, d]"
    return: "[a, b]; [c, d]"
    """

    result_text = ""
    replace = True
    for sign in text:
        if sign == '[':
            replace = False
        if sign == ']':
            replace = True
        if sign == ',':
            if replace:
                result_text += ';'
            else:
                result_text += sign
        else:
            result_text += sign

    return result_text
